jobs.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one tiny functional PNG icon for a Vietnamese strategy-game interface. Subject: One Vietnamese military victory standard standing upright: a plain vermilion rectangular cloth with two short swallow tails and a narrow ochre hem on a short bamboo pole. Style: extremely restrained Đông Hồ folk woodblock SYMBOL, thick slightly irregular warm-black ink outline, broad flat pigment shapes. It must read instantly when reduced to 20 pixels. At most TWO pigment fills besides the dark contour. Unadorned, graphic, 4–7 large shapes maximum. Empty breathing spaces wide enough to survive reduction. The folk character comes ONLY from the hand-cut silhouette, subtle irregular edge and traditional flat pigments. NO decorative motifs, filigree, flowers, spirals, tiny lines, hatching, stippling, paper grain, engraving, ribbons, gradients, glossy shading, 3D, background disc, scenery, text or shadows. Produce one isolated centered complete symbol on a genuinely transparent PNG background, alpha=0 outside the shape and through holes, with generous 12% empty margins on every side. The result should resemble a simple cut-paper woodblock UI mark, not a detailed illustration, souvenir or decorative emblem. Keep the visual language of a Vietnamese village folk woodcut and period objects, with only essential identifying details. Absolutely no drop shadow or glow; empty background has zero alpha.
